findings.summary: Lifecycle routing was only partially neutral: DEVELOPMENT_OPERATING_SYSTEM, the working decision header and work registry still asserted a permanent candidate/active state that a metadata-only READY descendant could not update.
The explicitly remediated routing documents correctly delegated status and preserved Gate D and capability boundaries.
The refinement semantic core, semantic lock, focused tests and protected scopes remained intact.

commands: verify remote head, tree and reviewed-content digest
inspect candidate and metadata-only READY lifecycle routing corpus
verify protected scopes and git diff --check
conclusion: Round 12 preserves the semantic model but still leaves canonical lifecycle contradictions outside the metadata-only READY allowlist. Semantic-model remains CHANGES_REQUIRED.
